headline: Amid Sell-Off, These 10 Stocks Become Foreign Investors' Targets
summary: The Jakarta Composite Index fell 0.92% on Friday and lost 3.71% over the week. Foreign investors were selling shares, and ten stocks drew foreign buying interest.
why: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) tracks the Indonesia Stock Exchange and is the main benchmark for the country's equity market. Foreign flows are a significant driver of its moves.
why_moved: The input cites foreign selling pressure during the week. It also reports the index's 0.92% decline on Friday.
original_headline: Di Tengah Aksi Jual, 10 Saham Ini jadi Incaran Asing
